request: Shared reaction animations that EVERY goblin will reuse (designed here on Snotskull Grunt, a typical goblin). He holds a frying pan in his right hand; keep it in his hand. Make them generic (no personality quirks), clear and cartoony. Use ctx.bone() word lookups (e.g. ctx.bone('right hand'), ctx.bone('spine')) rather than exact names so the same script works on other goblins. Rules from the owner for every goblin: nothing he holds ever goes through his body or the ground; feet stay planted (no sliding or sinking) unless the clip says otherwise; held items stay in the same hand; movements look weighty and cartoony, never floaty. Board games are seen from above and in front, so make poses read clearly from there.

animations.name: OH_Hit
animations.description: Takes a normal hit: head and chest snap back, one stagger step, shakes it off and returns to idle.

animations.name: OH_React_Knockback
animations.description: Shoved hard: arms fly up, upper body thrown backwards, skids (the game slides him back 1-2 spaces - he must not travel himself), windmills his arms and catches his balance.

animations.name: OH_React_Bonk
animations.description: Bonked on the head by a thrown skull: head snaps down, eyes-crossed dizzy wobble in a circle, shakes head and recovers.
